contract: ledger JSONL: UTF-8, <=4MiB, <=4096 lines, trailing newline, no dup keys, no unknown fields
event: id pattern, kind=task, task_index int 0..2^31, hex digests, version=event-gate/v1
event input must not carry prev_sha256 (derived from ledger tail)
append: apply appends canonical line with derived prev_sha256, fsync
strict consecutive task_index (last+1) else rejected, zero write
ledger itself must be appendable (chain intact) before any write
replay_noop: same id + identical derived line digest -> exit 0, no write
conflict_freeze: same id + different digest -> exit 1, zero write, action=conflict-frozen
version_drift: event version != v1 -> exit 1, zero write; drifted line in ledger fails gate
gate: verify full hash chain + index continuity + version uniformity
require last three task events each carrying evidence_sha256
fewer than 3 events / broken chain / missing evidence -> exit 1 with reason
PASS scope=ledger-bytes-only, no identity, no stage write

rollback: delete capabilities/event_gate/ directory; CI capability-tests auto-shrinks
